architectureDecision.reason: For these canaries Gateway adds no irreducible routing, policy, recovery, verification, or composition value. Direct provider MCP remains the natural path.
architectureDecision.reasonCustomSdkRejected: Two independent providers were handled by the existing official MCP Client; another discovery wrapper would duplicate the protocol owner without demonstrated irreducible semantics.
architectureDecision.providerAnnotationsBoundary: MCP ToolAnnotations are provider-owned hints/evidence inputs. They do not grant Ordivon authorization or prove effect occurrence.

localN8nInstance.livenessFinding: The rootless n8n units were generated but inactive with no failed unit; a reversible manual start restored readiness. Autostart/liveness is a Workstation owner gap, not Capability Fabric truth.
